units.source_text: 田园朦胧地展现，收割后的田地呈现出一派零绿色。

en.t: The countryside emerged hazily, and the harvested fields showed a stretch of pale green.

units.source_text: 田埂上的稀疏林木，高低大小错落有致，枝叶修剪得很高。

en.t: The sparse trees along the ridges varied pleasingly in height and size, with their branches and leaves trimmed high.

units.source_text: 细树干全部用当地称做蒸笼的稻草束围了起来，依次地在雾合中出现了，

en.t: The slender trunks were all wrapped in bundles of straw known locally as steamers, and appeared one after another in the mist,
looking exactly like ghosts of trees.

units.source_text: 有时，在车窗的紧跟前，以视野所不及的灰蒙蒙的田地为背景的一株相当鲜明的大柳树出现了，

en.t: At times, right beside the train window, a strikingly distinct great willow would appear against the gray, misty fields beyond the reach of sight,

units.source_text: 它沉甸甸地垂下湿透了的叶子，在雾霭中微微摇曳。

en.t: its soaked leaves drooping heavily as it swayed faintly in the haze.
